summary.title: Making Games with Python & Pygame
summary.one_liner: Learn to build 2D graphical games in Python with the Pygame library by reading annotated source code for seven clone games.
takeaways: Pygame basics: setting up a program, the game loop, event objects and handling QUIT
Drawing with surfaces, colors, Rect objects, primitive shapes, images, fonts, and sounds
Animation and frame rate control using pygame.time.Clock
Walkthroughs of complete game source code (Memory Puzzle, Slide Puzzle, Simulate and others) under 600 lines each
summary.summary: This free PDF book by Al Sweigart teaches intermediate Python programmers how to make graphical games with the Pygame library. It opens with installation and Pygame fundamentals such as the game loop, events, coordinates, colors, drawing, animation, fonts, and sound. The bulk of the book then presents the complete source code of several clone games (Memory Puzzle, Slide Puzzle, Simulate, and others) and explains how each program works.
